speaker: Leonard
text: Penny, for your thoughts. I'm fine. Penny's fine. The guy she's kissing is really fine.

speaker: Raj
text: What's the matter? So you're saying what, kind of kissing? Cheeks, lips, taste, French?

speaker: Leonard
text: I'm not jealous. I'm just a little concerned for her. I didn't like the look of the guy that she was with.

speaker: Raj
text: Because he looks better than you?

speaker: Leonard
text: Uh, yeah. He was kind of dreamy.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Please don't tell me that your hopeless infatuation is devolving into pointless jealousy. Well, at least now you can retrieve the black box from the twisted, smoldering wreckage that was once your fantasy of dating her and analyze the data so that you don't crash into Geek Mountain again.

speaker: Raj
text: I disagree. Love is not a sprint. It's a marathon. A relentless pursuit that only ends when she falls into your arms. I'll just see you at the chemistry.

speaker: Leonard
text: I'm done with Penny. I'm gonna be more realistic and go after someone my own speed. I don't know. Olivia Geiger?

speaker: Sheldon
text: The dietician at the cafeteria with the limp and the lazy eye? I don't think you have a shot there. I have noticed that Leslie Winkle recently started shaving her legs. Now, given that winter is coming, one can only assume she's signaling sexual availability.

speaker: Raj
text: I don't know. You guys work in the same lab. There are pitfalls. Trust me, I know. When it comes to sexual harassment law, I'm a bit of a self-taught expert.

speaker: Leonard
text: Look, Howard, if I were to ask Leslie Winkle out, it would just be for dinner. I'm not gonna walk into the lab, ask her to strip naked, and dance for me.
